_help: Settings for changemap.py. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Fill in during setup (BOOTSTRAP.md step 4).
_base_ref: Only commits after this ref count (e.g. upstream/main for a fork, or the commit where the project adopted this template). Empty = all history.
_upstream_ref: Optional. Switches that also exist in this ref are upstream's and need no card.
_branches: Every code commit reachable from these needs a card (reported by check, not an error). origin/<name> is used when the local branch is missing.
_code_paths: Path prefixes that count as code. A commit touching them is a code commit.
_skip_paths: Prefixes inside code_paths to ignore (vendored or generated code).
_switch_patterns: Python regexes that find switch names (env vars, config keys, feature flags) in the code. Group 1 is the name if the pattern has a group. Empty = no switch checks. Example: "\"(MYAPP_[A-Z0-9_]+)\"" finds string literals like "MYAPP_FAST_PATH".
_default_keys: Front-matter keys giving a card's default (on / off / n/a / mixed). One key, or one per platform or environment, e.g. ["default_windows", "default_linux"].
_areas: The card folders under research/changes/. One line each: what code belongs there.

areas.measurement: meter readings and measurement runs: tools/nearblack_probe.py (spotread driver, averaging, sweeps, DDC/CI), tools/display_power.py
areas.patchgen: test-patch generators that put exact signal values on screen: tools/hdrgen/ (native HDR10 swapchain, Windows/D3D11)
areas.profiles: corrections built from measurements and how they are installed: tools/build_mhc2.py (Windows MHC2 LUT profiles), tools/set_hdr_profile.py
areas.ddc: monitor control over DDC/CI: tools/ddc/ (backends, safety layer for VCP writes, capabilities parser, CLI)
areas.tooling: research tools, diagnostics, CI, build scripts (no product behaviour)

_test_id_patterns: Python regexes for test IDs in doc headings (see conventions.md, Test IDs).
_link_check: Files and folders whose relative markdown links check verifies.
_remote: The shared remote whose branches 'changemap.py branches' reads.
_branch_docs_exempt: Branch name patterns that need no reference file in research/branches/ (the main branches never do).
_queue_stale_days: changemap.py queue flags a Now row whose branch has had no commits for this many days.
